text:
sara-eng: Heads-up — spotted a recurring isolation signal affecting cust-omega Dedicated (VPC peering + onprem tunnel). Seen 3 flaps in last 10 days, customers hit latency + connection resets.

mike-sre: Ack. Can you paste the last few logs and the peering config? Any correlation with maintenance windows?

sara-eng: Pasted logs from last flap:```
2024-11-23T22:14:03Z peer:10.2.1.5 state=DOWN reason=ttl-exceeded
2024-11-23T22:14:05Z tunnel:omega-gw mtu_error detected packet=1508
2024-11-23T22:14:08Z svc-proxy evict key=kv-9fd3 fallback=redirect
```

ayana-ps: Customer runs an older onprem router that doesn't handle DF/MTU fragmentation well. They also have strict change freeze windows, so any config tweak needs a scheduled maintenance slot.

kevin-eng-infra: Possible short-term mitigations: 1) Reduce MTU on the peering interface to 1400, 2) add route to avoid fragmentation path, 3) enable prefix pinning on our side to reduce KV cache churn. I can own the infra patch for a canary.

mike-sre: I'll own triage + root cause. Need read-only access to customer router config and historical tunnel metrics. Can we get a two-hour slot for an escalated call? cc @ayana-ps to coordinate windows with cust-omega.

jordan-ml: FYI telemetry shows a 72-hr periodic spike in prefix churn that lines up with the flaps. When the churn exceeds threshold X we see cache evictions + connection resets. Could be a heartbeat + route-refresh interplay.

sara-eng: Proposed action items: 1) Triage isolation bug (mike-sre) - gather config + run pcap - ETA 2024-11-27, 2) Infra canary MTU change (kevin-eng-infra) - apply to canary peer and monitor 48h - ETA 2024-11-28, 3) Short-term routing rule to avoid frag path (kevin-eng-infra) - ETA 2024-11-28, 4) Eval KV cache pins and fallback behavior (jordan-ml + eng-runtime) - ETA 2024-12-02, 5) Customer comms + maintenance slot (ayana-ps) - ETA 2024-11-26.

kevin-eng-infra: I can push canary at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Will post canary checklist and rollback snippet.

ayana-ps: I'll ask cust-omega for the 09:00 UTC slot and request access for mike. If they refuse change window, plan B is monitor-only + config snapshot.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-240123-omega-peering, priority=P2, owners=[mike-sre, kevin-eng-infra], link=https://redwood/incs/INC-240123-omega-peering

mike-sre: Quick triage checklist for reference: ```
1) capture pcap on tunnel endpoint
2) run `show ip bgp neighbors` and export config
3) check kernel MTU/sysctl on gw
4) correlate with cache-evict logs from runtime
```

sara-eng: Thanks all. We'll follow this cadence: daily stand for next 5 business days, status update in this thread each morning. Next sync: 2024-11-26 15:00 UTC.

mike-sre: Taking ownership of the RCA thread. I'll post initial findings after the call.

sara-eng: Appreciate it — tag me if you need help drafting comms to the customer. :thumbsup:
